assessment.conclusion: The full r7/r8 diff is limited to the declared H and J1 cross-law amendments and their header, tables, names, controls, successors, units, findings, forbidden substitutes and disclosure records. The acceptance gate and item-16 row 8 are byte-identical to r7. FA-2's three C asks remain expressly outside scope.

Use 3 is faithful to H: core-produced inventory records in each record's own universe, only the three inventory relations, retained host-derived records, the four named field groups, and no symbol-inventory binding or candidate-producer result under that use. No language provider is falsely attributed an inventory record. Membership is syntax universe OR requested inventory cell, including an unavailable cell: ENC:53 permits the selected enumerator shape at null universe, and ENC:106 requires that core provider to be a direct Plan member. Import-only selection does not acquire direct membership. Cache producers remain forbidden.

assessment.item: One host inventory stage per universe, LD8-2
assessment.conclusion: Each selected universe reached by an available inventory binding has its own host inventory stage. Multiple bindings of that universe can name the same stage. This keeps view/universe attribution local. Inventory bindings in syntax universes name the H-owned inventory stage; other syntax bindings keep the E3 stage whose published outputs are syntax views and the candidate envelope. View-only output domains agree with EXC's existing derive-inventory-view pattern; SubjectInventory outcomes stay separately admitted host-derived inputs. Null-universe unavailable bindings have no stage and cannot fabricate Coverage at null universe. X-9 records the core operation/output-schema publication obligation and its fail-closed refusal.

No change-set observation supports a vcs-change fact or a complete negative. Unknown Coverage with provider-unavailable/capability-missing is the existing lawful pair for unavailable capability work. It is not an inference from dirty/index metadata, a Git object reader or a missing requested relation. File/package inventories remain unchanged; vcs-change is a capability relation, not an added inventory kind. X-9 routes the H3/H5 control.

The successor row carries both post-execution subject-scope bounds: over 100000 subjects with the exact count subject, and over 4 MiB canonical descriptor bytes in S-B's byte form. Typed refusal without truncation or splitting matches H's existing rule. H5's large-scope path remains gated on this projection.

The fresh per-invocation PROJECT-ID-V1 is the existing ProjectId semantic input, not a RequestId, ExecutionId, path, namespace locator or content-derived operational substitute. A registered root retains its admitted identity. An unregistered/no-I ephemeral root never persists the draw or compares it to registry/marker identity, and selects no store. Snapshot/Plan identities are explicitly incomparable across such invocations. This implements J1's E-2 recommendation without granting a writer, cache or regeneration identity.

No admitted trust view means no TR-INDEX-manifest admission, so the admitted component set is empty and no toolchain/stdlib/grammar context or universe is minted. Authenticated read-receipt core role closures survive. Requested cells remain retained unavailable bindings, with their host extents; inventory bindings can still name the selected core enumerator at null universe. RTC section 7.4 and the pinned lead ruling require ephemeral authority, no runId and no detail. The durable prerequisite detail remains under section 7.5. X-8 is a real required-cell/unselected-enumerator gap against the WS missing-required-provider golden. Its recommended narrow enumeration successor preserves required-cell indeterminacy; C4a/J2c affected legs wait, so no unlawful Plan or fabricated enumerator is authorized.

The changes match accepted H's X-H3/X-H5/X-H6 and record correction, J1's C half of S7b with the supplied RTC ruling, and M3-PLAN's CRC-2-before-C4a gate. CRC-2 explicitly supersedes CRC-1's contrary two-use text. The accepted D/SD-6 row-8 narrowing stays unchanged. E1's syntax outputs stay unchanged; X-10 records stage conformance and NB-MC8-1 identifies additional inherited E1 wording to conform. E-1's retained-root/tracking interface is honestly gated in X-11; the X4T halves, X-8, X-9, S-B and FA-2's excluded asks remain owned follow-on work. The law takes effect only once its unchanged M3-L gate is met.

acceptanceBoundary: Exact M3-C r8 law and contract soundness. The unchanged M3-L effect gate remains. No implementation, runtime qualification or unresolved companion interface is accepted by this verdict.
